description: This source file defines the Factory class in the OpenCart system, responsible for creating instances of controllers, models, and libraries based on sanitized route strings. It utilizes the registry and dynamic class instantiation, following a factory pattern for object creation within the OpenCart framework.

classes.name: Factory
classes.description: Class implementing a factory pattern for creating controllers, models, and libraries in the OpenCart system dynamically based on route strings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Factory object with a registry instance.

methods.name: controller
methods.description: Creates and returns a controller object based on the provided route string, or an exception if not found.

methods.name: model
methods.description: Creates and returns a model object based on the provided route string, or an exception if not found.

methods.name: library
methods.description: Creates and returns a library object, passing additional arguments, or an exception if not found.
